outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal, elective cesarean, emergent cesarean)
cohort: 241 high-risk obstetric patients referred to an outpatient anesthesia/analgesia antepartum clinic
finding: The study found that anesthesiology antenatal clinic consultations for high-risk obstetric patients allowed for tailored delivery management plans, with no maternal deaths and generally unremarkable neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was vaginal in 65% of women, elective cesarean section in 21%, and emergent cesarean section in 14%.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at consultation was 34.4 weeks (range: 20-37 weeks)
